purpose: Selection record for eight-position attend scoring plus a four-element value-pass unroll

baseline.description: Merged four-position attend scoring plus FP32 four-row column pairing

candidate.description: Score pass leads with an eight-position group (query loads shared across eight accumulators), four-position and scalar tails; the value pass unrolls four independent output elements per iteration. Both are bit-exact: per-position dot order, in-order max updates, and per-element accumulation order are unchanged.
candidate.note: The two changes are bundled as one bit-exact candidate; attribution between them is not separated.

kernel_results.median_ratio_summary: vs merged four-position attend: ~0.82-0.83x at hd128, ~0.89-0.92x at hd64, lengths 33-2048. Zero allocations.

generation_results.median_ratio_summary: ~0.98x on 128-token decode and ~0.98x on 129/257-length prefill one-token across two processes; every completion identical. Benefit scales with context length.

limitations: Single host; attend share is small at the measured lengths so generation deltas are modest
Bundle attribution between score pairing and value unroll is not separated
